concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-drop-in-setup-and-integration-android-v5]] - Android v5-routed Drop-in setup snapshot for client authorization, method-specific prerequisites, customer-scoped saved-method lookup, browser-switch overrides, and its source-specific 2026/2027 lifecycle notice; not proof of modular v5 package compatibility or current support
warnings: The /android/v5 documentation route does not identify the Android Drop-in package version; keep it separate from the retained drop-in@6.17.0 and modular braintree-android@5.30.0 baselines.
